name: Provenza
tagline: Every piece deserves a paper trail worthy of the piece.
positioning: Provenza authenticates and documents pre-owned luxury goods so individual sellers and collectors can prove what they own — before it ever hits the market.

hero.h1: Prove it's real before you sell it.
hero.sub: Provenza gives your handbag, watch, or sneakers a verifiable authentication record — photographed, expert-reviewed, and permanently linked to a certificate buyers actually trust.

features.title: Human experts, not just AI guesses
features.description: Category specialists review your submission — stitching, hardware, serials, weight — and sign off personally. No black-box verdicts, just a name and a rationale you can read.

features.title: A certificate buyers respect
features.description: Each authenticated item gets a shareable digital certificate with photos, findings, and a scannable code — the thing that ends 'is this legit?' haggling for good.

features.title: 48-hour turnaround
features.description: Snap the guided photos, ship if we need hands-on, and get your verdict in two business days. Most closet-clearing sellers finish a whole batch in a weekend.

features.title: Your permanent locker
features.description: Every piece you've authenticated lives in one place — receipts, care history, resale value estimates — so re-listing next season takes minutes, not archaeology.

features.title: Transfer it with the item
features.description: When you sell, the certificate transfers to the new owner in one tap. Provenance follows the piece, not your inbox, building real resale value over time.

features.title: Honest value estimates
features.description: See what comparable authenticated pieces actually resold for — grounded in real transactions, not wishful listing prices — so you price with confidence.

testimonials.quote: I inherited three Cartier pieces and had no idea what was real. Provenza's watch specialist walked me through every finding. I sold two with certificates and got 40% more than my first offers.
testimonials.name: Marisol Reyes

testimonials.quote: As a small consignment shop, I can't keep an in-house authenticator for every brand. Provenza's certificates are the reason my buyers stopped disputing and started repeat-purchasing.
testimonials.name: Daniel Okafor

testimonials.quote: I flip sneakers on the side. Having a signed authentication record attached to each pair basically ended the fake accusations in my DMs. Worth every dollar of the flat fee.
testimonials.name: Priya Venkataraman

pricing.blurb: One piece, one verdict, one certificate. Perfect for a first sale.

homepage.footerBlurb: Provenza authenticates and documents pre-owned luxury goods for the people who actually own them. Real experts, permanent records, honest values.
